ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pixels with a low ratio (estimated <10%) of high-intensity white pixels localized to linear and circular scarring features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark-gray/black pigmentation base across both lobes; high-contrast white linear and circular clusters are distributed sporadically, with higher density in the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 135 degrees and a well-defined central convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (saw-tooth pattern) along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular high-contrast white clusters detected on the ventral surface, particularly concentrated in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants of the lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel streaks (rake marks) of varying lengths crossing the pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable reddish-brown textured masses or appendages attached to the far distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive reddish-brown coloration on the extreme edges of the lobe tips, contrasting with the primary grayscale fluke pigmentation.
